nodes.description: Storage.State _state: root storage struct holding epoch, balance, provider, pools, candidates, accounts and collateral lists
uint256 _status: ReentrancyGuard lock variable (_NOT_ENTERED/_ENTERED)
Implementation.advance(): permissionless epoch driver, requires msg.sender == tx.origin, mints incentive and runs Bonding/Regulator/Market step()
Implementation.initialize(): guarded by initializer modifier, enables all pools
Bonding.step(): checks epochTime() > epoch(), snapshots dollar supply and increments epoch
Regulator.step(): reads oracle price and grows/shrinks supply
Market.step(): automatically redeems coupons for the current epoch
Govern.vote(): requires msg.sender == tx.origin, records bonded stake weighted votes and locks account
Govern.commit(): quorum + governor checks then upgrades proxy to candidate implementation
Govern.emergencyCommit(): super-majority + governor checks then upgrades proxy
Collateral.redeem(): nonReentrant redemption of dollar into collateral assets held by the contract
Bonding.claim(): pays pending dollar rewards for msg.sender in a pool
Bonding.deposit(): transfers LP tokens from user into staged balance
Bonding.withdraw(): onlyFrozen withdrawal of staged LP tokens
Bonding.bond(): claims pending dollar, moves staged LP into bonded balance
Bonding.unbond(): moves bonded LP back to staged and unfreezes the account
Bonding.provide(): adds liquidity into a Uniswap pair and bonds the received LP tokens
Market.purchaseCoupons(): burns user dollar and mints coupons expiring after the coupon expiration window
Market.extendCoupon(): burns dollar to extend the expiration epoch of existing coupons
Market.clipCoupons(): pays out clippable dollar for redeemed coupons
Market.transferCoupons(): coupon transfer with allowance accounting
Market.approveCoupons(): sets coupon allowance for a spender
Upgradeable.upgradeTo(): sets new implementation in the EIP-1967 slot and delegatecalls initialize()
Comptroller.mintToAccount(): mints dollar to an account and increases protocol debt
Comptroller.burnFromAccountForDebt(): pulls dollar from user, burns it and reduces recorded debt
Comptroller.clipToAccount(): transfers clippable dollar out of the system
Comptroller.increaseSupply(): mints fund rewards, tops up redeemable pool and distributes to LPs
Comptroller.setDebt(): overwrites total debt and resets it against the debt ratio cap
Setters.preClaimDollar(): computes and transfers pending dollar rewards for msg.sender before accounting update
Setters.postClaimDollar(): writes back rewardDebt for msg.sender after a claim/bond state change
Setters._sellAndDepositCollateral(): mints dollar and sells it into every pool via Uniswap swap calls
Setters._addLiquidity(): quotes paired amounts, pulls both tokens from user and mints LP tokens to the contract
Getters.pendingReward(): view of pending dollar reward for msg.sender in a pool
Collateral.addCollateral(): governance-only registration of an accepted collateral asset
Bonding.addPool(): governance-only registration of a Uniswap pool
Comptroller.mintToLPs(): mints dollar and accrues accDollarPerLP proportionally to pool allocations
ReentrancyGuard.nonReentrant modifier: checks and sets _status around the guarded body
IUniswapV2Pair(pool).swap(...) external call selling dollar into pools within _sellAndDepositCollateral
newImplementation.delegatecall(abi.encodeWithSignature("initialize()")) executed inside upgradeTo
dollar().transfer(msg.sender, pending) token transfer executed in preClaimDollar before rewardDebt is updated
IERC20(addr).safeTransfer(msg.sender, ...) collateral payout in Collateral.redeem before debt is burned
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom pulling LP/token balances from msg.sender in deposit and _addLiquidity
assembly { sstore(slot, newImplementation) } writing the EIP-1967 implementation slot in setImplementation
oracle().capture() external call supplying the price used to drive supply policy in Regulator.step
msg.sender: caller identity used for accounting, claims, votes and access checks
tx.origin: used in equality checks against msg.sender in advance() and vote()
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time source behind epochTime()/epoch() and the Advance event
uint256 candidate parameter of Govern.vote
uint256 candidate parameter of Govern.commit
uint256 candidate parameter of Govern.emergencyCommit
uint256 value parameter of Collateral.redeem
uint256 dollarAmount parameter of Market.purchaseCoupons
uint256 amount parameter of Bonding.provide
address account parameter of Comptroller.mintToAccount
uint256 pending local reward amount computed in preClaimDollar
uint256 vsdAmount local in Market.clipCoupons
Candidate.VoteInfo memory newVoteInfo built in Govern.vote
address pool parameter of Bonding.bond
uint256 bondedVotes local stake snapshot computed in Govern.vote

edges.reason: advance() reads msg.sender and requires it to equal tx.origin before running epoch logic
advance() compares msg.sender against tx.origin, so authorization depends on tx.origin
advance() emits block.timestamp and triggers Bonding/Regulator/Market steps whose epoch math derives from block.timestamp
advance() calls Bonding.step()
advance() calls Regulator.step()
advance() calls Market.step()
advance() -> incentivize() -> mintToAccount(msg.sender, advanceIncentive)
advance() is declared nonReentrant, so the guard wraps the whole epoch driver
nonReentrant modifier reads and writes the _status lock variable
Govern.vote() requires msg.sender == tx.origin
Govern.vote() keys proposals, vote records and stake on msg.sender
Govern.vote() uses epoch()/periodFor() windows that depend on block.timestamp
Govern.vote() records the newVoteInfo struct built from the caller's bonded stake
Govern.vote() derives bondedVotes from balanceOfBondedDollar(msg.sender)
Govern.commit() calls upgradeTo(address(candidate)) after quorum and governor checks
Govern.emergencyCommit() calls upgradeTo(address(candidate)) after super-majority and governor checks
commit() candidate parameter selects the proposal state that is validated and upgraded to
emergencyCommit() candidate parameter selects the proposal state that is validated and upgraded to
vote() candidate parameter indexes proposal creation and the recorded vote
upgradeTo() delegatecalls initialize() on the attacker-supplied candidate implementation address
upgradeTo() -> setImplementation() performs an assembly sstore of the implementation slot
Collateral.redeem() pays out collateral with safeTransfer before burning the redeemer's debt
Collateral.redeem() sends collateral to and pulls collateral fees from msg.sender
Collateral.redeem() is protected by the nonReentrant guard
Collateral.redeem() finishes by calling burnFromAccountForDebt(msg.sender, actual, debt)
redeem() value parameter drives redemption-rate and fund-split arithmetic as well as the burned amount
Bonding.claim() first calls preClaimDollar() which performs the external dollar transfer
Bonding.claim() then calls postClaimDollar() to checkpoint the reward debt
preClaimDollar() transfers pending dollar before postClaimDollar() updates rewardDebt, leaving a reentrancy window
preClaimDollar() computes the pending local from bonded amount and accDollarPerLP
preClaimDollar() reads poolInfo.accounts[msg.sender] to size the payout
postClaimDollar() writes the recomputed rewardDebt into _state.pools[pool].accounts[msg.sender]
preClaimDollar() reads and mutates per-account pool accounting held in _state
pendingReward() reads poolInfo.accounts[msg.sender] to compute the pending value
burnFromAccountForDebt() mutates _state.balance.debt through decrementTotalDebt
increaseSupply() reads and rewrites _state balances and coupon totals while minting
setDebt() writes _state.balance.debt directly
clipToAccount() mutates _state.balance.clippable via decrementTotalClippable
mintToAccount() increases _state.balance.debt after minting dollar
mintToLPs() writes accDollarPerLP and allocation data in _state
addCollateral() pushes an asset into _state.collateralAssetList
addPool() sets flags and pushes a pool into _state.poolList
Bonding.bond() claims pending dollar before changing bonded balances
Bonding.bond() updates rewardDebt after the bonded balance is incremented
Bonding.unbond() claims pending dollar before moving balances
Bonding.unbond() updates rewardDebt after the bonded balance is decremented
Bonding.provide() delegates LP acquisition to _addLiquidity()
_addLiquidity() uses safeTransferFrom to pull both pool tokens from msg.sender
Bonding.deposit() pulls LP tokens from the user with an external transferFrom call
provide() amount parameter determines quoted paired deposit and the minted LP amount
bond() pool parameter selects which pool state the bonded balance is credited to
purchaseCoupons() burns the caller's dollar through burnFromAccountForDebt
purchaseCoupons() dollarAmount parameter drives coupon premium computation and coupon minting
purchaseCoupons() derives the coupon expiration epoch from epoch()/gotCouponExpiration timestamps
extendCoupon() liveness arithmetic on couponExpireEpoch depends on the timestamp-derived current epoch
clipCoupons() pays out clippable dollar through clipToAccount()
clipCoupons() holds the redeemed amount in the vsdAmount local before payout
Regulator.step() -> growSupply() -> _sellAndDepositCollateral()
Regulator.step() consumes the oracle().capture() price to decide supply policy
Regulator.step() epoch accounting and events depend on timestamp-derived epoch()
_sellAndDepositCollateral() performs Uniswap swap callbacks into pool contracts mid-accounting (source comment 'Non-Reentrancy?')
Bonding.step() requires epochTime() > epoch(), both computed from block.timestamp
Market.step() redeems outstanding coupons tracked inside _state
increaseSupply() distributes the remaining new supply to LPs via mintToLPs()
mintToAccount() credits the supplied account parameter with freshly minted dollar
commit() governance windows are derived from epoch()/startFor/periodFor which depend on block.timestamp
emergencyCommit() eligibility depends on epoch() proposal state derived from block.timestamp

normalization_plan.reason: candidate is the proposal identifier consumed only by Govern.vote for indexing candidates and vote records
candidate is the proposal identifier read by Govern.commit to validate and upgrade to
candidate is the proposal identifier read by Govern.emergencyCommit to validate and upgrade to
value is the redemption amount feeding Collateral.redeem arithmetic and burn
dollarAmount is the burn/premium amount used exclusively by Market.purchaseCoupons
amount is the liquidity amount used exclusively by Bonding.provide
account is the mint recipient used exclusively by Comptroller.mintToAccount
pending is the pending reward computed and transferred inside Setters.preClaimDollar
vsdAmount is the clippable amount computed and paid out inside Market.clipCoupons
newVoteInfo is the vote record assembled and stored inside Govern.vote
pool selects the pool state updated by Bonding.bond
bondedVotes is the stake snapshot used to weight the vote inside Govern.vote
